listed_quote.quote: has gone through a careful methodical process to evaluate options for GCIC, including an IPO, a listing of the company’s shares on a national securities exchange, a merger with various parties including GBDC, and the status quo.

announcement.quote: announced today that it has entered into a definitive agreement to merge with Golub Capital BDC, Inc. (“GBDC”) with GBDC as the surviving company, subject to certain stockholder approvals and customary closing conditions.

outcome_evidence.quote: On September 16, 2019, Golub Capital BDC, Inc., a Delaware corporation (“GBDC”), completed its previously announced acquisition of Golub Capital Investment Corporation, a Maryland Corporation (the “Company”)

deals.notes: GCIC appears unlisted: its filings show capital drawdown notices and Regulation D private sales to stockholders, and its 8-K cover pages show no exchange registration, while the acquirer GBDC is on The Nasdaq Global Select Market. The merger itself was approved by both sets of stockholders on 2019-09-04 and completed 2019-09-16 (the evidence shown), so it is not a failed deal.
